source_request: 리서치한 키워드 중 3가지를 뽑아서 실제로 이미지에 그 키워드에 대한 내용이 반영되었는지를 테스트하는 테스트케이스를 추가해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트에서 각각의 테스트 주제로 아까 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정해서 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Evaluate whether an independently conceived industrial transport editorial photograph can visibly realize a contrapposto weight shift as observable full-body load-bearing geometry while using the supplied photograph only to guide facial appearance.
subject: An original adult woman working as a night-ferry vehicle-deck loadmaster, fully clothed in operational protective workwear, with facial appearance guided only by the provided reference photograph.
setting: A working roll-on/roll-off ferry vehicle deck at night, between numbered loading lanes near the illuminated ramp.
event: During a cargo-securing inspection, she pauses to mark a checklist while turning her attention toward an arriving truck.
visual_priorities: A full-body view with unmistakable one-leg load bearing, a relaxed free leg, counter-tilted shoulders and pelvis, and a natural asymmetric torso curve.
Credible ferry-deck operations conveyed by protective workwear, wet anti-slip steel, numbered lanes, chain tensioners, secured cargo, ramp lights, and vehicle lamps.
Professional documentary realism with physically plausible joints, work-focused expression, and unobstructed hips, knees, ankles, and both feet.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic transport-operations editorial photograph of an original adult woman working as a night-ferry vehicle-deck loadmaster, fully clothed in a zipped navy coverall, reflective safety vest, steel-toe boots, hard hat, and work gloves. Her facial appearance is guided only by the provided reference photograph. On a working vehicle deck at night, she pauses between numbered loading lanes beside secured cargo chains while checking a clipboard. Capture her full body in a clearly readable natural contrapposto: nearly all body weight settles through one straight supporting leg; the opposite knee bends and its foot rests lightly ahead without bearing load; the pelvis drops on the free-leg side while the shoulders counter-tilt, producing a relaxed S-shaped alignment through the torso. One gloved hand marks the checklist as she turns toward an arriving truck. Prioritize unmistakable load-bearing asymmetry and authentic ferry-deck details: wet anti-slip steel, chain tensioners, ramp lamps, and distant vehicle lights. Keep the moment professional and documentary, with natural workwear folds and unobstructed hips, knees, ankles, and both feet.
